_doc: Material table, manufacturer standard datasheet values (owner decision 2026-11-18: material is a per-part setting; parts may differ). density in g/cm3. nozzle_mm_default = manufacturer recommendation. 'legacy_paht_cf_fast_check' reproduces the old fast_check mass numbers only; it is not a default. 'fem' = elastic constants and reference strengths for the FEM check: orthotropic FDM {E_inplane_MPa, E_layer_MPa, G_MPa, nu, tensile_XY_MPa, tensile_Z_layer_MPa} (the layer-normal axis is a per-part setting) or isotropic {E_MPa, nu, reference_strength_MPa}. Datasheet entries (Bambu ...) are the standard; legacy_* entries reproduce numbers of the old per-study FEM tables and are named so they are never picked by accident. For the Bambu data sheets G and nu are not published: nu 0.35 (as the legacy FDM sets) and G = E_inplane / (2 (1 + nu)) are our assumptions. 'print' = manufacturer printing limits and thermal values from the same data sheets (temperatures in C, overhang angle as the data sheet states it (its angle convention is fixed by the overhang check), bridge length mm, HDT at 0.45 / 1.8 MPa): the printability checks read them, so a material change or a run override (--process material=...) changes every result that depends on it. bambu_studio_filament: the Bambu Studio system filament profile per nozzle for the slicer check.

Bambu PAHT-CF.source: Bambu Lab PAHT-CF technical data sheet
Bambu PAHT-CF.fem_source: Bambu Lab technical data sheet V2.0 (dry): E, tensile X-Y / Z as in docs/research/design-checks.md; G, nu assumed

print.drying: 80 C, 8-12 h; print and store below 20 % RH
